name: v0.9.0
body:
## Added

- Every key now shows in Settings under Keys, where you can change it by pressing the new one or reset it. Keys you set are kept in `[keys]` in `config.toml`, take effect when you save, and a line that cannot be used is reported without undoing the others. (#59 by @ekvedaras)
- One change on the screen is now focused, marked by a thin accent bar. `Tab` and `Shift+Tab` move between changes, `Down` and `Up` scroll through a long change and then move on, and a click focuses the change it is in. `[` and `]` show 20 more lines above or below it, like the gap buttons. All six keys can be changed in Settings. (#61 by @ekvedaras)
- Settings has a "More lines" number, 1 to 200 (20 by default), for how many lines one step of the arrows on a gap and the `[` and `]` keys shows. (#61 by @ekvedaras)
- The page now has a scrollbar on its right edge: it shows where you are, and you can drag it or click its track to jump. (#53 by @ekvedaras)
- A file box that shows several parts of one file has a Labels button in its header and an `L` key (on the focused change's file) that hides or shows the thin `Class::method` lines marking where each part starts. A file whose parts are mostly one or two changed lines, like an interface, now opens with the labels hidden. (#63 by @ekvedaras)
- The header of a file box now stays at the top while you scroll through its code, and names the symbol you are in. (#53 by @ekvedaras)
- `R` switches the focused change's file between Code and Rendered, the same as the switch in its header. Both `R` and `L` can be changed in Settings and are in the shortcuts list and the command palette. (#63 by @ekvedaras)
- Press `S` to hide or show whitespace-only changes and `A` to ask about the step you are on. Both are listed in the shortcuts sheet and the palette, and can be changed in Settings. (#62 by @ekvedaras)

## Changed

- An outdated comment thread no longer folds by itself. Only resolving it, or folding it yourself, folds it. (#53 by @ekvedaras)
- The screen shown while a tour is being written is now one plain page: the same ground behind the sidebar, the title bar and the page, no scroll-like line, edges or shadows around the page and under the title bar, and no frame around the agent's lines. (#60 by @ekvedaras)
- While the tour refreshes, the banner shows what your claude is doing right now, such as the file it reads, so you can see that a long refresh is still working.
  The suggestion of a full redo hides while a refresh runs. (#52 by @ekvedaras)
- The Hide whitespace, Wrap lines and Ask buttons above a step's code now show their key on the button, using the key you set, and nothing when you removed it. (#62 by @ekvedaras)

<details><summary>Commits</summary>

- release 0.9.0 (dc170b8)
- keys: fix the merge with per-file keys (Command::ALL size, keymap import) (6559605)
- wiki: progress of the simple keys (614316a)
- keys: S hides whitespace, A asks about the step, toolbar buttons show their key (eae05c2)
- wiki: progress sha (4de3685)
- wiki: R switches back, label rule from the full diff (56af1a3)
- A rendered file keeps the focus so R switches it back; the label starting rule counts the full diff (8882749)
- wiki: per-file keys and piece labels progress (7cd9d22)
- snapshots: scenes for a file box's piece labels, shown and hidden; the pinned header scene shows its labels (f4e9b71)
- R and L act on the focused change's file; piece labels hide per file, starting hidden when most pieces change one or two lines (c1adb80)
- wiki: cite the commit for the one-page writing screen (08176fb)
- loading screen: one ground behind sidebar, title bar and page; no shadow under the header bar (8b5a2fe)
- wiki: one More lines decision, dated 2026-11-13 (42caecc)
- snapshots: a scene for Settings' More lines section; the Keys scene counts the new section (d4de557)
- settings: how many lines one more-lines step shows is a number the reviewer sets (more_lines, 1 to 200), used by the gap buttons and [ ] (59f6844)
- focused change: a snapshot scene, the glossary word Change, a change note and the wiki progress (eb63d16)
- focused change: the keys work in the window, the page follows the focus and an accent bar marks the focused change (7bcc86a)
- focused change: a click focuses a change, the focus follows the scroll, and Down and Up scroll through a tall change before moving on (a335c51)
- focused change: Tab and Shift+Tab step through a screen's changes; [ and ] show 20 more lines through the gap buttons' own request (7073f85)
- keys: Tab, Shift+Tab, Down, Up, [ and ] are commands with default keys; they do nothing yet (716bacb)
- loading screen: a plain page while the tour is written, with no page line, edges, shadows or frame around the lines (fb539b2)
- wiki: keys and focus decisions from the maintainer's tries (da8f842)
- settings keys: the buttons' column is wide enough for Change and Reset, so the caps line up (6d223ad)
- wiki: keys and focus progress for the Keys section (e6dd17a)
- settings: a Keys section lists every command with its keys, a Change that takes the next key pressed, Reset and Remove; the wrap tooltip names the key it is bound to (ed8271b)
- keys: read [keys] from config.toml into a keymap that buttons, the sheet and the palette show; one bad line keeps the others, a toast points to Settings, and Save applies the keys at once (3978c0d)
- AGENTS: crop PR pictures to the part that changed (19c7d70)
- pinned file header: keeps the box's fold arrow, so its text does not move; folding from it scrolls back to the box (c84271f)
- pinned file header: take over only when the real header reaches it; gpui's row bounds leave out the list's top padding (6714c63)
- threads: an outdated thread starts open; only resolving or the reviewer folds it (1574ffe)
- page: a scrollbar on the right edge shows where the view is; drag the thumb or press the track to move it (84f3572)
- diff view: the pinned file header is square, flush with the step bar (c1d69f8)
- diff view: a file box's header stays pinned under the step bar while its code scrolls, naming the symbol the reader is in (952ce21)
- snapshots: 45-refresh-running stages a refresh mid-run; AGENTS: a PR that changes what the app shows carries before and after pictures (220540c)
- refresh banner: the redo suggestion hides while a refresh runs (f1beb99)
- refresh: the banner shows the tool your claude uses now, read from its stream-json lines; an error result fails the refresh with its reason (a5c781b)
- tests: fake apps and the stop-turn test wait for the CLI, not the clock, so a busy machine cannot fail them (#37) (81ac5e3)

</details>

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/ekvedaras/guided-review/compare/v0.8.1...v0.9.0
